title: Houseplants & Indoor Jungle Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=planta:plant) OR (index=personal sourcetype=govee:soil)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="planta:plant","primary",sourcetype="govee:soil","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from planta:plant and govee:soil to see whether two houseplants feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `planta:plant` and `govee:soil` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main houseplants data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
